fee_rounding: ceil to the cent once per aggregate order
cash_baseline: HYPOTHETICAL_CASH_AT_SETTLEMENT_TIME for holds; assumed sale cash at the stop signal for stops
quote_rule: bid and ask present, bid <= ask, spread <= 10 cents, volume > 0 or a prior quality bar
clock_rule: NBA Q2/Q3 on HIGH/MEDIUM as-of snaps; NCAAB period 1 remaining <= 600s or period 2 remaining > 600s
unproven_first: a first quality bar already at or above 78 cents is UNPROVEN_FIRST
chronology_unresolved: an entry bar whose low is already at or below 67 cents is not booked
primary_family: OCT_2025 REF equal-weight mean net cents per admitted contract
OCT_2025 JOINT_2_FEE_007 equal-weight mean net cents per admitted contract
APR_2025 REF equal-weight mean net cents per admitted contract
APR_2025 JOINT_2_FEE_007 equal-weight mean net cents per admitted contract
primary_estimand: unweighted mean across admitted trades of net_pnl_cents / contracts
null_procedure: studentized day-cluster bootstrap of the centered statistic, or P_VALUE_NOT_ESTIMABLE
sharpe: calendar-day E_end/E_previous-1, zero-activity days retained, realized and marked separate
hypothesis_rule_frozen_before_results: A partial-coverage window cannot support the hypothesis. It can weaken the sign only when the available subset mean is <= 0. A complete normalized window can say the historical sign survived REF, and separately whether it survived JOINT_2_FEE_007. A rising balance is not an OOS pass. Launch stays NOT_YET_IDENTIFIABLE.
